summary: thedata ships opaque openssl-encrypted blobs exported on import
details: index.js re-exports rsaKey and desKey from apps/docs/app/theta.js, which readFileSync's rsa.db and des.db from the package tree. Both files decode to binary payloads beginning with the openssl 'Salted__' header (openssl enc ciphertext). The package itself contains no code that decrypts, evaluates, executes, or transmits these blobs; there are no install lifecycle hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall), and no network I/O, credential reads, or filesystem writes outside the package's own directory. Installing or importing thedata by itself does not execute the payloads. The shape is consistent with a stager/payload-carrier intended to be paired with a companion module that decrypts and runs the blobs; on its own, this tarball performs no installer-side action.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
